ocl:
context User
inv: (self.posts->exists(x | x.isPublic = false)) and (self.posts->notEmpty())

context Membership
inv: (self.group <> null) and (self.user <> null)

context Membership
inv: (self.user <> null) and (self.role <> null)

context Message
inv: (self.sender <> null) and (self.body <> null)

context Comment
inv: (self.post.isPublic) and (self.text <> '' and self.text.size() > 0)

context Tag
inv: self.posts->any(x | x.isPublic <> false) <> null

context Conversation
inv: self.participants->any(x | x.createdAt <> '') <> null

context Post
inv: (self.isPublic = false) and (self.comments->forAll(v | v.createdAt <> ''))

context Post
inv: (self.isPublic <> true) and (self.reactions->forAll(v | v.createdAt <> ''))

context Media
inv: (self.post <> null) and (not(self.post <> null))

context Conversation
inv: ((self.messages->any(x | x.isRead = true) <> null) and (self.participants->size() = 1)) and (not((self.messages->any(x | x.isRead = true) <> null) and (self.participants->size() = 1)))

context User
inv: ((self.notifications->any(x | x.isSeen = false) <> null) and (self.notifications->notEmpty())) and (not((self.notifications->any(x | x.isSeen = false) <> null) and (self.notifications->notEmpty())))

context Message
inv: (self.conversation <> null) and (not(self.conversation <> null))

context Conversation
inv: (self.participants->collect(x | x.notifications)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.participants->collect(x | x.notifications)->size() >= 1))

context Conversation
inv: (self.participants->forAll(x | x.email <> '')) and (not(self.participants->forAll(x | x.email <> '')))

context FriendRequest
inv: ((self.createdAt <> null) and (self.isAccepted = true)) and (not((self.createdAt <> null) and (self.isAccepted = true)))

context Follow
inv: (self.follower <> null) and (not(self.follower <> null))
